negative_findings.description: Searched in Serbian/Montenegrin for a UBCG statistical bulletin ('bilten', 'statistički pregled', 'sektorski podaci'). Every 'bilten' hit for Montenegrin banking resolves to the Central Bank's Bilten CBCG, not to the association.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence that UBCG publishes its own periodic statistical bulletin with member-aggregated card/ATM/POS data; its recurring publications are the Bankar magazine, the annual work programme and the annual activity review.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not expect association-sourced aggregates to substitute for CBCG payment statistics in Montenegro; the association's statistical value is mainly in magazine articles and conference decks.

negative_findings.description: The site menu advertises a PUBLIKACIJE section at https://ubcg.info/publikacije/ but the fetch returned HTTP 404. A guessed archive path https://ubcg.info/casopis-bankar/ also returned 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: Publications are in practice reachable only as individual dated posts (e.g. /2026/02/13/bankar-br-72/) and as direct wp-content/uploads PDF URLs. Treat the 404 as a moved/renamed page, not as a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector keyed on /publikacije/ would silently collect nothing; the harvester must instead walk monthly archives and the uploads directory.

negative_findings.description: The association is commonly assumed to sit on 'ubcg.me'; searches confirm the live property is ubcg.info (with /en/ mirror). The acronym UBCG also collides with 'Udruženje bibliotekara Crne Gore' (librarians) at ubcgc.ac.me.
negative_findings.result_summary: Noisy acronym — queries on 'UBCG' alone return librarian-association and University of Montenegro bulletin results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must pair 'UBCG' with 'banaka'/'banking' to avoid a polluted crawl frontier.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Serbian for a Montenegrin microfinance-institutions association, a leasing association and a card/payment-scheme industry body.
negative_findings.result_summary: No such standalone associations surfaced; non-bank financial institutions appear to be covered either by CBCG supervision pages or by the Chamber of Economy's combined banking/finance/insurance board.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sector self-reporting outside banks proper is thin in Montenegro — the aggregation function sits with CBCG and, secondarily, with the Chamber board.

negative_findings.description: The 2024 activity review PDF fetched as a largely image-based document with little extractable text.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association PDFs may require OCR; content was not readable through plain text extraction.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline over UBCG PDFs needs an OCR stage or the annual reports will be silently empty.

brief: Montenegro's sector self-reporting layer is centred on one actor, Udruženje banaka Crne Gore (UBCG), whose live property is ubcg.info (not ubcg.me) and whose membership covers all 11 licensed banks — making its member page a high-value pointer into every bank-level disclosure cell. UBCG does not publish a statistical bulletin; its substantive output is the long-running practitioner quarterly 'Bankar' (issues from at least no. 16/2011 to no. 72/2026, all as PDFs under wp-content/uploads), plus annual work programmes/activity reviews, a SEPA section, card-fraud education from its payment-card misuse commission, and a dense news feed of instant-payment and PSD3/IPR workshops. Because association-side numeric aggregates are scarce, the practical statistical yield in this cell comes indirectly: EBF's annual Montenegro Facts & Figures, the Chamber of Economy's banking/finance/insurance board sessions, the INFINTECH conference in Tivat, and the bankar.me trade portal that quotes figures from decks and association statements. Main risks for a collector are the 404 /publikacije/ menu link, image-only PDFs requiring OCR, and the noisy 'UBCG' acronym that also denotes the librarians' association.
